extensions.name: timescaledb
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS timescaledb;
extensions.notes: Required only for databases using TimescaleDB hypertables or compression.

extensions.name: pg_stat_statements
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_stat_statements;
extensions.notes: Core contrib extension available from the PostgreSQL base image.

extensions.name: vector
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
extensions.notes: Dense vector type and indexes.

extensions.name: vchord
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vchord;
extensions.notes: VectorChord indexing extension.

extensions.name: vchord_bm25
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vchord_bm25 CASCADE;
extensions.notes: BM25 sparse ranking. Usually used with pg_tokenizer.

extensions.name: pg_tokenizer
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_tokenizer;
extensions.notes: Tokenizer support for BM25 search.

extensions.name: age
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS age;
extensions.notes: Apache AGE graph database extension.

extensions.name: pgmq
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgmq;
extensions.notes: Postgres-backed message queues.

extensions.name: pg_cron
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_cron;
extensions.notes: Requires cron.database_name for the database that owns jobs.

extensions.name: pg_repack
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_repack;
extensions.notes: Online table and index reorganization.

extensions.name: pg_partman
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_partman;
extensions.notes: Partition management extension.

extensions.name: pg_ivm
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_ivm;
extensions.notes: Incremental materialized view maintenance — refreshes only changed rows instead of full REFRESH. High value for analytics aggregations (finops cost rollups, dashboards) that would otherwise need full recompute on every write.

extensions.name: pg_duckdb
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_duckdb;
extensions.notes: Catalog only — DuckDB submodule build not yet in the CNPG image bundle. Embeds DuckDB for vectorized OLAP; enable only on analytics-facing clusters after packaging lands.

extensions.name: wrappers
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS wrappers;
extensions.notes: Supabase FDW collection — S3/Garage, Stripe, BigQuery, Firebase, Airtable, Clickhouse, Redis as foreign tables. Useful for finops collector reading from Garage S3 or external billing APIs directly via SQL.

extensions.name: rum
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS rum;
extensions.notes: RUM index access method — full-text search with timestamp ordering in a single index scan. Faster than GIN + ORDER BY ts_rank for time-sorted full-text queries.

extensions.name: hypopg
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS hypopg;
extensions.notes: Hypothetical indexes for query planning.

extensions.name: pg_hint_plan
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_hint_plan;
extensions.notes: Planner hints for exceptional query tuning cases.

extensions.name: plpgsql_check
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS plpgsql_check;
extensions.notes: Static analysis and runtime checks for PL/pgSQL.

extensions.name: pg_trgm
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm;
extensions.notes: Core contrib trigram indexes and fuzzy text matching.

extensions.name: unaccent
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS unaccent;
extensions.notes: Core contrib accent-insensitive text normalization.

extensions.name: btree_gin
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS btree_gin;
extensions.notes: Core contrib B-tree operator classes for GIN indexes.

extensions.name: btree_gist
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS btree_gist;
extensions.notes: Core contrib B-tree operator classes for GiST indexes.

extensions.name: pgstattuple
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgstattuple;
extensions.notes: Core contrib table and index bloat inspection.

extensions.name: amcheck
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS amcheck;
extensions.notes: Core contrib index and relation corruption checks.

extensions.name: pageinspect
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pageinspect;
extensions.notes: Core contrib low-level page inspection for incident debugging.

extensions.name: postgres_fdw
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS postgres_fdw;
extensions.notes: Core contrib foreign data wrapper for PostgreSQL-to-PostgreSQL access.

extensions.name: pgcrypto
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;
extensions.notes: Core contrib cryptographic helpers and random data functions.

extensions.name: pg_prewarm
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_prewarm;
extensions.notes: Core contrib cache warming for important tables and indexes.

extensions.name: pgaudit
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgaudit;
extensions.notes: Detailed database audit logging. Preload and configure only where audit volume is acceptable.

extensions.name: uuid-ossp
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp";
extensions.notes: Legacy compat only. PG18 has gen_random_uuid() (v4) and uuidv7() as built-ins — no extension needed for new code. Enable only for existing apps calling uuid_generate_v4() that cannot be migrated.

extensions.name: hstore
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS hstore;
extensions.notes: Core contrib key-value store type. Prefer JSONB for new code; enable for apps that use hstore columns.

extensions.name: citext
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS citext;
extensions.notes: Core contrib case-insensitive text type. Useful for email and username columns; simpler than lower() indexes.

extensions.name: ltree
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS ltree;
extensions.notes: Core contrib hierarchical label tree type and operators. Efficient ancestor/descendant queries without recursive CTEs.

extensions.name: intarray
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS intarray;
extensions.notes: Core contrib integer array functions and GiST/GIN indexes. Efficient set membership and intersection queries.

extensions.name: pg_buffercache
extensions.create_extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_buffercache;
extensions.notes: Core contrib shared buffer cache inspection. Useful for diagnosing what is and isn't cached during performance investigation.
